text:
maya.k: hey team — our free-trial balance dropped from 500 -> 30 credits overnight. We didn't run any big jobs. Noticed our scheduled rerank job (every 10m) started spiking retries. Can someone look?

alex_su: sorry to hear that. do you have request ids or a sample log from the worker? sounds like the client may have retried on 5xx and each attempt consumed credits.

maya.k: pasted a snippet from our worker logs:
```
2026-03-16T23:42:10Z INFO calling /v1/rerank candidates=128 job_id=rr-84
2026-03-16T23:42:10Z WARN response 502 id=req_0a1b2c3
2026-03-16T23:42:11Z INFO retrying attempt=1 id=req_0a1b2c3
2026-03-16T23:42:11Z INFO response 200 id=req_0a1b2c3 tokens_charged=128
2026-03-16T23:52:10Z INFO calling /v1/rerank candidates=128 job_id=rr-84
2026-03-16T23:52:10Z WARN response 502 id=req_0d4e5f6
2026-03-16T23:52:11Z INFO retrying attempt=1 id=req_0d4e5f6
2026-03-16T23:52:11Z INFO retrying attempt=2 id=req_0d4e5f6
2026-03-16T23:52:12Z INFO response 200 id=req_0d4e5f6 tokens_charged=128
```
we run this job across 4 pods, same schedule, so the retries multiplied. Our client is python requests with a retry wrapper (max_retries=3, backoff=linear).

lee_oncall: thanks — this matches an anomaly we saw in the billing pipeline. the rerank endpoint charges per request/candidate regardless of HTTP status; retries that eventually succeed will still show as separate billed calls because the service treats every accepted POST as a billable evaluation. if the 502 returned early and the client retried, each successful attempt gets billed.

sam_support: pinged billing infra for a ledger dump. @billing_bot can you attach the audit elements for maya@acme-inc?

billing_bot: automated: found 1,872 /v1/rerank calls between 2026-03-16T00:00:00Z and 2026-03-16T23:59:59Z for acct acme-inc. Total trial credits consumed: 470. Root cause tag: client_retries_after_502. Reference ticket: BILL-1102.

maya.k: ugh — so retries still charge? is there any quick mitigation? we can't change the job too fast — it's used to keep rankings fresh.

alex_su: short term: disable automatic retries in your worker (set max_retries=0) or use idempotency keys so the server can detect duplicate submissions. medium term: we'll refund trial credits and add warning docs for scheduled jobs. can you confirm job schedule (every 10m) and batch size (candidates=128)?

maya.k: confirmed schedule=10m, candidates=128, pods=4. happy to disable retries for now.

lee_oncall: action items for infra/eng: 1) add guardrail in platform docs calling out rerank/embeddings non-idempotency and retry billing semantics; 2) evaluate server-side detection of duplicate/rerun within short window (idempotency-awareness); 3) create an alert for sudden per-account spike in rerank requests. filing RUNTIME-1971.

sam_support: I've created a billing escalation and issued a one-off trial credit refund of 470 credits to acme-inc (internal refund id REF-1769). told maya to re-enable job only after disabling client retries.

maya.k: thanks — refund showed up. appreciate the tip about idempotency. will deploy a fix (disable retries + linear backoff to 30s).

alex_su: follow-up: we should also audit SDK defaults — our python SDK currently retries on 502/503/504 by default which surprised users. will open SDK-514 to change default to no automatic retries for endpoints that are not idempotent (embeddings/rerank).

lee_oncall: noted. marking this thread resolved after docs + refund + SDK issue filed. :white_check_mark:
